waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it, and TLC already stops with an evaluation error when an action leaves a variable unspecified.

mutations.name: drop-fencing
mutations.why: Commit no longer compares the claim token: a stale holder can commit after another worker did.

mutations.name: remove-fairness
mutations.why: Without WF on Commit and Abort a worker holding a claim may never finish, so ClaimedEventuallyDone must fail by stuttering.
mutations.search: Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ \A w \in Workers : WF_vars(Commit(w)) /\ WF_vars(Abort(w))
